h1: Dyson V11 trigger replacement, printed plastic only
answer_first: We print a replacement plastic trigger that fits the Dyson V11 cordless vacuum, from your photos. We do not touch electrical parts, only the plastic trigger. Quote within 24 hours, from $16.
fits: Dyson V11 cordless vacuum trigger (confirm by photo)
problem: The V11 trigger is a small plastic lever that you press every time you clean, and it snaps at its pivot. The vacuum works, but you cannot turn it on without the trigger.
oem_situation: The original trigger is sold only as part of a whole handle. The most-downloaded free fix has 2,630 downloads, which shows how common the failure is.
our_part: We print only the plastic trigger, in PA-CF, carbon-fibre nylon, because the pivot takes repeated load. We do not touch electrical parts: the switch, battery, motor and wiring are untouched, and you fit the trigger yourself. We need photos of the broken trigger and the handle slot, with a coin for scale.

how_to_order: Photograph the broken trigger and the handle area where it sits.
Send photos on the request page, with a coin or ruler in the shot and the model number if you have it. We reply with a quote within 24 hours on business days.
Approve the quote and we print the part, usually in 5 to 10 business days after approval, then ship it to you.

faqs.q: Do you repair the switch or battery?
faqs.a: No. We do not touch electrical parts. We print only the plastic trigger, and the switch, battery and wiring are not part of the service.

faqs.q: Is a printed part as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed PA-CF is strong in most directions, but a layer-line direction exists: the part is weakest where layers pull apart. We orient the print so the main load runs along the layers, and we tell you if a part is a poor candidate. The pivot is the part that fails, so we orient the print so the layers do not split there.

faqs.q: How do I measure or photograph the part?
faqs.a: Photograph the broken trigger, the handle slot and the pivot pin, with a coin for scale on a plain background with a coin or ruler beside it, from the top, the side and the mounting end. Also send the model number, usually on a sticker inside the door, under the unit or on the product label. If you still have a broken piece, photograph that too.

faqs.q: Will fitting it affect my warranty?
faqs.a: It may. Check your Dyson warranty before you open the handle, since opening the vacuum is your decision.

faqs.q: Why not buy the whole handle?
faqs.a: The whole handle is the only original option and costs far more than a trigger. A printed trigger replaces just the broken plastic.
